Subject: SIG questionnaire and artifact ask — next steps

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for sending over the SIG template earlier. We completed the questionnaire and attached it, but before we finalize we need Redwood to provide the following artifacts to close our security review: SOC 2 Type II report (most recent), a one-page pen test summary (redacted is OK with details on severity/impact), ISO/ISO-related statements (if applicable), and your latest security overview deck.

Can you confirm a realistic delivery window for each item? Veridian prefers having everything in our secure intake by next Friday (2027-04-09) but if you can stagger delivery that works too — SOC2 + deck earlier is ideal. Also, we will ask procurement for any LOA/NDA uploads if needed.

Attached: Veridian_SIG_filled.xlsx

Appreciate it — Lucas
Security Lead
Veridian Health

Hi Lucas —

Thanks, and appreciate the filled SIG worksheet. Short answer: we can meet Veridian's window with a staged delivery. Proposed schedule below:

- SOC 2 Type II (redacted): delivery by Wednesday 2027-04-07 EOD (PDF via secure share).
- Security overview deck (PDF): delivery by Wednesday 2027-04-07 EOD.
- Pen test summary (one-page redacted): delivery by Friday 2027-04-09. We need to coordinate redaction for specific CVE details (see note).
- ISO statement / attestation: single-page confirmation (we hold ISO27001 statement) — available immediately; attaching official statement.

Im attaching an artifact tracker (artifact-tracker.xlsx) so we can mark items off as theyre uploaded. Links to an encrypted share will be provided in my follow-up when the files are staged.

Quick ask: does Veridian need DocuSign or an upload to a specific portal? If procurement needs an LOA or additional metadata, loop them in and well include the required cover note.

Attachments (local): artifact-tracker.xlsx, Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2023_redacted.pdf (placeholder)

Thanks — Kimberly Park

Thanks Kimberly — that schedule looks good. A couple quick clarifications:

- For the pen test summary, redaction of exploit POCs is fine; wed like to preserve a list of findings with severity levels (Critical / High / Medium / Low) and whether they were remediated or mitigated.
- For SOC 2, redacted PDFs are acceptable, but please retain assertion dates and auditor name.
- Procurement: well accept uploads to our secure intake portal (procurement@veridianhealth.com) or a pre-signed S3 link — whichever is easier for your team.

If you prefer, we can provision a temporary intake folder for Redwood.

— Lucas
